latestVersion.changelog:
Video Chinese 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly adds accurate Chinese subtitles to uploaded videos (up to 500MB, MP4/MOV/AVI/WebM).
- Seamless workflow: upload video, request Chinese captions, and download 1080p MP4 output.
- Built-in cloud GPU rendering completes typical jobs in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session, user auth, and credit management — no manual setup needed.
- Supports checking job status, export/download, and balance via simple chat prompts.
